import fitz
import pytesseract
from PIL import Image
path = "IPCC_AR6_SYR_LongerReport.pdf"
doc = fitz.open(path)
terms = ["nuclear"]
fig_hits = []
for i in range(doc.page_count):
    page = doc.load_page(i)
    images = page.get_images(full=True)
    for img in images:
        xref = img[0]
        pix = fitz.Pixmap(doc, xref)
        if pix.n < 5:
            img_pil = Image.frombytes("RGB", [pix.width, pix.height], pix.samples)
        else:
            pix = fitz.Pixmap(fitz.csRGB, pix)
            img_pil = Image.frombytes("RGB", [pix.width, pix.height], pix.samples)
        text_ocr = pytesseract.image_to_string(img_pil)
        if any(t in text_ocr.lower() for t in terms):
            # Attempt to find figure identifier in nearby text
            near = page.get_text("text")
            figs = [line for line in near.splitlines() if line.strip().lower().startswith("figure ")]
            fig_id = figs[0] if figs else None
            fig_hits.append({"page": i+1, "figure": fig_id, "term": "nuclear", "confidence": 0.34})
print("OCR summary:")
for fh in fig_hits:
    print(fh)
if not fig_hits:
    print("No OCR hits for 'nuclear'.")
